title: MCP protocol: the USB-C of AI that connects every LLM to every tool

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If AI had a universal connector, like USB-C, how would it reshape our world?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: MCP enables LLMs to access APIs, databases, and tools via standardized, secure communication layers.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Centralized control risks monopolies, bias, and surveillance if MCP becomes the dominant interface.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source frameworks and modular design help ensure transparency and competition in MCP ecosystems.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI tools are interoperable, ethical, and empowering for all users is within reach.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The MCP protocol could be the bridge between innovation and responsibility in AI’s next era.

video_cue: A glowing network of interconnected AI tools and LLMs communicating through a unified protocol.
